objective: Close the G1 verification and review baseline without adding G2 feature capability.
allowed_files: G1 implementation files already changed on branch codex/g1-domain-closure
tests and test infrastructure required to correct deterministic G1 or repository baseline failures
canonical migration, rollback, compatibility, and development documentation
forbidden: New G2.1 or later domain tables, commands, routes, workflows, or UI
Destructive git cleanup or reverting unrelated worktree changes
Weakening assertions merely to make failing tests green
Independent approval, merge, deploy, release, or ship claims
evidence_contract: Complete command results and failure classification
Maintainer-grade review findings with file and line references
Residual risks and explicit external review gate
